standards.title: Occupational Health and Safety Management Systems — Requirements
standards.summary: Provides a framework for managing occupational health and safety (OH&S) risks and opportunities. Based on the Plan-Do-Check-Act model. Replaces OHSAS 18001.

standards.title: Environmental Management Systems — Requirements
standards.summary: Specifies requirements for an environmental management system to enhance environmental performance, fulfil compliance obligations, and achieve environmental objectives.

standards.title: Risk Management — Guidelines
standards.summary: Provides guidelines on managing risk faced by organizations. Risk management framework includes risk identification, analysis, evaluation, treatment, monitoring, and communication.

standards.title: Psychological Health and Safety at Work
standards.summary: Provides guidance for managing psychosocial risks within an OH&S management system. Covers work organization, social factors, and work environment that may affect health.
